## 3. Most important divergence — c99a5bd: the constitution asserts a safety net this repo does not have
c99a5bd landed docs/CONSTITUTION.md 'standardized' from a sibling project and kept references to infrastructure that is absent here. L86-87 claim an executable 'Article IX check' step in .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml that refuses auto-merge on protected paths — but origin/main's .github/workflows/ contains only ci.yml and sync-upstream.yml; there is no auto-merge.yml and no auto-merge path at all. L124-131 state the warden-digest and tastewatch-digest cron entries are 'in .warren/triggers.yaml' — the triggers.yaml merged in the same window (8e3e573, amended by 5a8e314) defines only the five patrol entries; no warden or tastewatch-digest entry exists. Article IX also protects agents/*.md and .canopy/, neither of which exists on main. Net effect: the population's own mandate overstates its guardrails, and the protected files it names (CONSTITUTION.md itself, .warren/triggers.yaml L1-47) were in fact edited three times this week with zero executable review path in place. Secondary: the same commit's sync-upstream.yml uses a floating DeterminateSystems/nix-installer-action@main (L17) and a hardcoded auto-commit message (L36) that will mint ritualized, untruthful 'chore:' commits every 6h (Art I/III adjacency); ci.yml and sync-upstream.yml install Nix two different ways in the same commit — foreign idiom accreting.
Related (8e3e573, .warren/config.yaml L4): the agentImage was changed from a content-addressed pin (ghcr.io/nacosolutions/senshac-warren-agent@sha256:5f44b7b…) to floating ghcr.io/rogernavelsaker/warren-agent:latest — an unpinned mutable agent image, the kind of change the owner would veto (candidate amendment, off-article).

## 5. Proposed amendment (one; proposal only, Art IX)
Add an executable Article IX guard and de-phantom the constitution:
a) New job in .github/workflows/ci.yml (concrete): on pull_request, list changed files (tj-actions/changed-files or a checkout+diff); if any path is in {docs/CONSTITUTION.md, .warren/triggers.yaml, .warren/agent.json, .github/workflows/auto-merge.yml} AND the PR lacks label 'human-approved', fail the job with 'Article IX: protected path changed without human approval'.
b) Amendment PR (human-merged) to docs/CONSTITUTION.md: replace L86-88 'Executable form' paragraph to name the new ci.yml job; replace agents/*.md / .canopy/ in Art IX with .warren/agent.json; strike or mark-as-not-yet-implemented the warden-digest/tastewatch-digest paragraph (L122-131) until those entries exist in .warren/triggers.yaml; pin or remove the floating @main action reference in sync-upstream.yml guidance.

## 6. Trajectory
Drifting — but first-week onboarding drift: the mandate, patrols, and CI all landed within five days, four of five commits are small and honest, and the drift is a standard that overstates its own guardrails rather than rot in the code.
